title: High Wire Basket And Twin Returned U Stand Tennis Hopper
description: One independently authored complete empty tennis-ball-hopper-inspired fixed stand. A high rectangular five-sided basket is a single connected finite wire lattice with real front, rear, end and bottom openings and an open top. Two whole long returned U-shaped frames descend from the four upper basket corners to separate low transverse ground bars. Four complete closed fixed pivot-cap exteriors join their upper ends, and two whole long ground sleeves supply broad finite flat soles. Nine complete closed meshes and three opaque constant PBR roles, metre-style native Z up and centred grounding. All basket grid and U-frame coordinates and topology are new, not an old shopping cart with wheels removed and not an appliance basket extracted. One original model zero scenes; repeated caps do not count separately.
